root_cause_analysis: The Instagram Graph API returned an OAuthException (code 4, subcode 2207051) indicating an application-level request limit or action block, likely due to excessive posting frequency or automated activity patterns triggering Meta's security filters.
actionable_instructions: Wait at least 60 minutes before attempting to publish again to allow the rate limit window to reset.
Verify if the Instagram account has been flagged for suspicious activity via the Meta Business Suite dashboard.
If the block persists, manually post the carousel via the Instagram mobile app to confirm account status.
